title: Option Colors
description: Changes toggles such as On/Off and Yes/No to be green and red instead of white
body: # | DESCRIPTION | Makes any text with ON/OFF or Yes/No red when inactive and green when active. The only situation where it doesn't currently work is when there are multiple ON states (such as the Narrator button in Chat Settings) Also try [this pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/more-readable-settings) from another creator if you would like more settings to be colored (not just on/off and yes/no) # | VERSIONS | Currently supports Minecraft Java ```1.13-26.2```. Some versions may show up as incompatible; this is due to having only one file and Minecraft not accepting pack format ranges until recently. The resource pack will work as far back as 1.13. # | COMPATIBILITY | Incompatible with packs modifying the lang files in certain ways ## | Patreon | Join my new Patreon to support my projects!
